# Dataset Mapping

Mapping a dataset is a crucial step in preparing your dataset for downstream functionality such as project creation.
​
Mapping creates transparency between:
*   Your intended use of the dataset
*   Omnisient’s expectations for how the dataset should be structured (required columns and recommended additional columns)
# Where to find Dataset Mapping
Dataset mapping is available in the following areas of the platform:

| Location | How to access it |
| ---| --- |
| My Datasets → Unregistered & Available datasets | Dataset row context menu → Map Dataset (also available from the dataset detail view)<br><br>![](https://t9012824942.p.clickup-attachments.com/t9012824942/3cf8b265-a2a8-4ee5-8754-797e66e3aa8d/image.png) |
| Own Data Preparation | Via the Dataset Mapper widget<br><br>![](https://t9012824942.p.clickup-attachments.com/t9012824942/522c30e2-14a8-4fb6-ad8a-685c444c1518/image.png) |

🔐 Permissions
Dataset mapping is enabled by default for Admin users.
Non-admin users can access the Dataset Mapper if they are assigned the permission.

# How Dataset Mapping works
When you open the Dataset Mapper from either entry point, a bottom sheet will open with a two-step flow:
1. Select
2. Map
## Step 1: Select
In this step, you choose the dataset you want to map and assign its dataset type.
![](https://t9012824942.p.clickup-attachments.com/t9012824942/40330d44-796e-4288-ba70-3dbcf6713ee3/image.png)
### Dataset selection behavior

| Entry point | Behavior |
| ---| --- |
| My Datasets | The dataset dropdown is pre-populated with the selected dataset |
| Own Data Preparation | The dataset dropdown displays all Unregistered and Available datasets within your organization.<br><br>To make it easier to differentiate dataset states, the dropdown includes an icon next to each dataset indicating whether it is Unregistered or Available. |

📚 Dataset types determine which fields are required and which additional fields are recommended during mapping. You can view supported dataset types and mapping requirements [here](https://app.clickup.com/9012824942/docs/8ck9jve-21812/8ck9jve-46272).

## Step 2: Map
After selecting the dataset and dataset type, Step 2 will automatically populate with the mapping fields for that dataset type. These fields are grouped into:
*   Required fields
*   Additional fields

![](https://t9012824942.p.clickup-attachments.com/t9012824942/c540242e-3977-4c3b-8341-3b4c2b573603/image.png)
### Required vs Additional fields

| Field type | Required to save | Notes |
| ---| ---| --- |
| Required fields | ✅ Yes | Must be mapped for the dataset mapping to save successfully. |
| Additional fields | ❌ No | Strongly recommended to maximize the usefulness of the dataset. |

⭐ Recommendation
While only required fields must be mapped, we highly recommend mapping additional fields as well to get the most out of your dataset.

### Data Type icons
Each mapping field is paired with an icon representing its data type.
Use these icons to quickly confirm that you're mapping a dataset column to the correct field type and to ensure your mapping is consistent.

| Icon | Dataset Type |
| ---| --- |
| ![](https://t9012824942.p.clickup-attachments.com/t9012824942/5d36b423-6317-4fc5-94db-47668e46d4e9/image.png) | Boolean |
| ![](https://t9012824942.p.clickup-attachments.com/t9012824942/94928df9-5fc5-4c27-9beb-fa052c462e32/image.png) | Datetime |
| ![](https://t9012824942.p.clickup-attachments.com/t9012824942/e437d321-181e-4921-bdc7-2914fc6229b4/image.png) | Decimal |
| ![](https://t9012824942.p.clickup-attachments.com/t9012824942/66bf0558-7fb8-420e-90c2-3c59b76d5c3e/image.png) | Integer / Number |
| ![](https://t9012824942.p.clickup-attachments.com/t9012824942/92ecfd85-a42a-482e-803d-dc58af13a882/image.png) | String |

# Omnisient Academy

# Table of Contents
* * *
# Overview
Our **Omnisient Academy** is the dedicated hub where our customers and staff (hopefully coming soon) equip themselves with the skills and confidence to unlock the full potential of our platform. Built on **LearnWorlds**, it provides structured, self-paced courses that guide users through essential workflows and best practices with certifications at the end of each course.

* * *
# Vision
Our Learning Academy is the gateway for customers and staff to become confident, skilled, and strategic with our platform. What begins as step-by-step onboarding will grow into a world-class learning journey that empowers people to unlock business value from their data.

✨ **From foundations to mastery:**
*   **Click-by-click tutorials** to get started with data uploads and project templates.
*   **Use-case playbooks** that show how to apply data for real business impact, from financial inclusion to audience activation.
*   **Strategic mastery and certifications** that position learners as recognized experts in securely unlocking alternative data for their industries, with the potential to **monetize certifications** as valuable credentials in the broader data and business ecosystem.

With certifications and completion certificate, we want users to showcase their ability to work with alternative data for specific use cases, with achievements that highlight their expertise while strengthening our brand as a trusted leader in data-driven innovation.

The Academy will evolve alongside our platform, ensuring every learner, whether a new customer, power user, or internal team member, has the knowledge to unlock data securely, confidently, and with measurable business results.

* * *
# Proposed Structure \[WIP\]
1. **Foundational Level**
    1. Getting started with the platform
    2. Secure data handling
    3. Introduction to core workflows
2. **Intermediate Level**
    1. Working with different data sources
    2. Best practices for data preparation
    3. Building effective projects
3. **Advanced Level**
    1. Applying data for business impact
    2. Optimizing data for specific outcomes
    3. Governance and compliance
4. **Specializations / Mastery Tracks**
    1. Role- or outcome-based deep dives
    2. Advanced application of platform capabilities
    3. Certification pathways
5. **Internal Staff Training**
    1. Platform knowledge and workflows
    2. Customer enablement and support skills
    3. Advanced troubleshooting and internal alignment

# Academy Content
## Content Feeds
*   **Platform Features and Updates**: New workflows, integrations, or templates should automatically trigger content creation or updates.
*   **Customer Feedback and Support**: Common questions, pain points, or feature requests gathered from support tickets, success calls, and surveys provide direct input into priority topics.
*   **Internal Expertise**: Product managers, data scientists, and engineers contribute deep knowledge that can be translated into accessible learning.
*   **Industry Trends and Use Cases**: External developments and best practices help situate platform training within real-world business applications.

## Evaluating Course Content
*   **Relevance**: Does the course align with current platform capabilities and customer needs?
*   **Clarity**: Is the information presented in a way that learners of varying skill levels can understand and apply?
*   **Practicality**: Does the course connect actions on the platform to measurable business outcomes?
*   **Consistency**: Is the tone, structure, and branding aligned with the rest of the Academy and Brand?
*   **Engagement**: Does the course use visuals, examples, and interactive elements to hold attention? What are the engagement metrics?
*   **Certification Value**: Does completion provide a meaningful skill marker for the learner?
